summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository, but nothing has been run; tests are unverified. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn after BarColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now means finished_time is present; capture in Progress.update and advance inside the lock; clear in Task._reset and Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with type-checking-only Table import and in-method imports); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section with Added entries for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__, the latter beyond the spec); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns and its expected string updated). The test_columns expected string was derived by hand-tracing clock reads: start-frame elapsed 0:00:37 and 0:00:36, final-frame 0:01:00 and 0:00:45; bars shrink by 8 in start frames (33 to 25) and by 7 in final frames (23 to 16) because the speed column narrows once both speeds read 1 byte/s. Run-length edits were verified by pattern matching. Other existing progress tests were reasoned to be unaffected but not run. No commits made.
